name: Classic Antarctica Air-Cruise
flight: Round trip: fly south, fly north

seo.title: Classic Antarctica Air-Cruise by Antarctica21: 8 Days
seo.description: Antarctica21's most popular trip: fly two hours from Punta Arenas to King George Island and spend four days on the Antarctic Peninsula aboard an 88-guest Magellan ship.

tagline: Antarctica21's most popular air-cruise: eight days, no Drake crossing.
answer: The Classic Antarctica Air-Cruise is Antarctica21's eight-day, seven-night trip from Punta Arenas, Chile, and the one it calls its most popular. Guests fly about two hours to King George Island, then spend four days aboard Magellan Explorer or Magellan Discoverer, 88 guests at most, among the South Shetland Islands and the western Antarctic Peninsula.
overview: Days 3 to 6 are spent between the South Shetland Islands and the western Antarctic Peninsula, with daily Zodiac landings led by guides and talks on board. Antarctica21 says the route may include the Antarctic Sound, the Gerlache Strait and the Penola Strait.

itinerary.title: Start of the air-cruise
itinerary.summary: Arrive in Punta Arenas and transfer to the hotel. Check in at Explorers House before 2 PM for the mandatory briefing, then the welcome dinner.

itinerary.title: Scheduled flight to Antarctica
itinerary.place: King George Island, South Shetland Islands
itinerary.summary: A flight of about two hours to King George Island. Guests walk past Chile's Frei Station and Russia's Bellingshausen Station to the shore, then board the ship by Zodiac.

itinerary.title: Exploring Antarctica: South Shetland Islands
itinerary.summary: Landings and Zodiac cruises chosen on the day.

itinerary.title: Exploring Antarctica: Antarctic Sound
itinerary.summary: Listed by Antarctica21 as a possible area.

itinerary.title: Exploring Antarctica: Penola Strait or South Shetlands
itinerary.summary: Listed as a possible area, before the ship returns to King George Island.

itinerary.title: Scheduled return flight
itinerary.place: King George Island to Punta Arenas
itinerary.summary: Fly from King George Island back to Punta Arenas and transfer to the hotel for the night. Meals in Punta Arenas that evening are at your own expense.

itinerary.title: End of the air-cruise
itinerary.summary: Breakfast at the hotel, then a group transfer to Punta Arenas airport.

faqs: How long is the Classic Antarctica Air-Cruise?
Eight days and seven nights, starting and ending in Punta Arenas, with four days exploring Antarctica.
Do I have to sail the Drake Passage?
No. You fly over it both ways, about two hours each way.
Magellan Explorer and Magellan Discoverer, up to 88 guests each.
What happens if weather delays the flight?

Antarctica21 flies only when King George Island weather allows. Outbound, it keeps trying from Day 1 until 2 PM on Day 4, with Punta Arenas tours, meals and the Day 1 hotel covered while guests wait. If guests still cannot fly by then, the trip is cancelled and Antarctica21 refunds 100% of the cruise fare. On the way back, the ship keeps cruising until the flight is cleared, or guests fly up to a day early.
How much luggage can I take on the flight?

25 kg (55 lb) per person in total, hand luggage included, with no single item over 20 kg. Extra allowance cannot be bought. On the Classic and Polar Circle air-cruises, excess luggage is held in Punta Arenas until you return.
